length_controlled.attention_direction: positive means more stale-relative attention on failures
length_controlled.qk_direction: negative means current-to-stale QK displacement on failures

qk_definition: rotated QK(current)-max rotated QK(stale), scaled by sqrt(head_dim)

raw.attention_direction: positive means more stale-relative attention on failures
raw.qk_direction: negative means current-to-stale QK displacement on failures

shuffle_protocol: labels permuted within (template, seed); extrema taken over all heads
